tax.text: Cowan calls for tax relief for families and small businesses.
tax.quote: Get real results on affordability by delivering meaningful tax relief for families and small businesses, investing in American workers, and strengthening domestic industries — not selling our future to foreign adversaries.

immigration.text: Cowan supports securing the border, enforcing existing laws and ending policies that reward unlawful entry.
immigration.quote: We must secure the border, enforce existing laws, and end policies that reward illegal entry. Reform the legal system to work faster for those who follow the rules — but American jobs, wages, and security always come first.

guns.text: Cowan opposes new gun restrictions for law-abiding citizens and favors prosecuting violent offenders and investing in mental-health intervention.
guns.quote: I am a strong defender of the Second Amendment and do not support new restrictions on the gun ownership rights of law-abiding citizens.

abortion.text: Cowan identifies as pro-life, supports legal protection for human life and opposes elective late-term abortion while allowing exceptions for rape, incest and the mother’s life.
abortion.quote: I am pro-life and believe in protecting the sanctity of human life. I also believe there are circumstances for exceptions — including when the life of the mother is at risk, in cases of rape, and in cases of incest.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Cowan strongly agreed that biological males should be excluded from women’s sports and female-only spaces.
gender.quote: Biological males should not be allowed to participate in women's sports or occupy biological women's spaces whether it be bathrooms, locker rooms, sorority houses, women's shelters, or prison.

health.text: Cowan supports retaining Medicare and Medicaid while relying on market competition rather than expanding government-funded coverage.
health.quote: Medicaid and Medicare serve an important role as a safety net, but the answer to our healthcare challenges is more competition and less government, not the other way around. I support market-based reforms that lower costs, expand choices, and put patients back in charge of their own care.

energy.text: Cowan supports an all-of-the-above, market-led energy policy focused on cutting regulation and keeping energy affordable.
energy.quote: Unleash American energy — all of the above. The federal government needs to stop picking winners and losers. Cut the red tape, let the market work, and keep energy affordable for Georgia families.

voting.text: Cowan supports citizenship verification, election-security measures and greater ballot-counting transparency.
voting.quote: Require proof of citizenship to vote, secure our election infrastructure, and demand full transparency in how ballots are cast and counted — make it easy to vote and impossible to cheat.

tax.text: Harden supports middle-class tax relief while requiring large corporations and wealthy Americans to contribute more.
tax.quote: Working families should not pay a higher effective tax rate than multinational corporations. Chris will fight for middle-class tax relief while ensuring that large corporations and the wealthiest Americans contribute their fair share.

wages.text: Harden supports raising the minimum wage so full-time work can provide a stable living.
wages.quote: He also supports raising the minimum wage so a full day’s work pays for a full day’s living.

trade.text: Harden said tariffs should be stopped because they increase consumer costs.
trade.quote: You know, one of the things, obviously we need to stop the tariffs, but we also need to end these forever wars.

debt.text: Harden says he would protect and strengthen Medicare and Medicaid while reducing patients’ costs.
debt.quote: He will work to protect and strengthen Medicare and Medicaid, cap out-of-pocket costs for life-saving medications, expand access to mental health services, and improve rural access to care.

schools.text: Harden supports strong public schools and investment in public education and workforce programs.
schools.quote: Every child deserves a quality public education, and every adult deserves a real path to economic opportunity. Chris supports strong public schools, career and technical education, apprenticeship programs, workforce training, and affordable routes to higher education.

abortion.text: Harden calls reproductive freedom a fundamental right and supports access to abortion and other reproductive care.
abortion.quote: Chris believes reproductive freedom is a fundamental right. Women in Georgia’s 11th District should have access to the full range of reproductive healthcare, including contraception, fertility treatment, maternal and prenatal care, and abortion care.
